expectations.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
expectations.evidence: 31 of 32 confirmed judged findings are a ground-truth defect or a real problem (strict: 26 of 32); recall by meaning 13 of 14 seeded defects. Grader: Of the 32 findings with method 'judged', 26 map to seeded defects, 5 are real but not seeded (F-0025, F-0039, F-0105, F-0067, F-0076) and 1 is not a problem (F-0058). That gives precision (26+5)/32 = 0.969 and strict precision 26/32 = 0.813. Recall by meaning is 13/14 over all 35 findings (D13, the slot length shown only in a tooltip, is missed). Over the judged findings alone it is 11/14, because D02 and D11 come only from the tool findings F-0019 and F-0015.

expectations.text: Severity ratings land in the expected bands for most matched defects
expectations.evidence: by the graders' mapping: 12 of 13 found defects have a mapped finding rated within band ± 0.5 (by the script's criterion matcher: 11 of 14 rated matches within band ± 0.5)

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' contrast 3.02:1 (amber on amber tint, 16px bold)
grader_mapping.reason: Amber #bd7d0f text on a #fbefda tint at 16px bold measuring about 3.0:1 is the 'Few left' tag contrast failure.

grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The slot grid runs 15 px past the viewport at 320 px and the page scrolls sideways.

grader_mapping.title: No visible focus on slot button 08:00
grader_mapping.reason: Focusing a slot button changes no pixels, so there is no visible focus on the slot buttons.

grader_mapping.title: Focus order jumps back from 08:00 to 08:20 Few left
grader_mapping.reason: Focus jumps around the grid because the 'Few left' slots are moved visually out of DOM order.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled-booking page keeps the heading 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: The cancelled state comes only from the double press. D09 covers the done page that still reads 'Booked' while the booking is cancelled, which is narrower than D09 but the same harm.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled-booking page title reads 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: The same misleading cancelled done page that D09 describes ('is titled Booked'), reported through the page title.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-slot error gives no recovery step; slot shown as '—'
grader_mapping.reason: After the hold lapses, the slot is dropped and the summary shows a dash with only 'This slot is no longer available.' This is the D08 expired-hold harm.

grader_mapping.title: Selected day barely distinguishable under forced colours
grader_mapping.reason: Residents who use Windows high-contrast or forced colours can hardly see which day button is pressed: only a 1 px border difference shows it, while other selected controls get the Highlight colour. The day named in text softens this but does not remove it.

grader_mapping.title: Second press of 'Book this slot' cancels the booking
grader_mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s wait turns the booking into a cancellation, and the done page still says 'Booked'.

grader_mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no pending state during the 1.5 s wait
grader_mapping.reason: Book stays enabled and shows no progress while the booking is made. The instructions place this under D09.

grader_mapping.title: Slot list has no loading state; Next silently does nothing
grader_mapping.reason: The grid and status line are blank for about 0.9 s with nothing marking the wait, and Next returns without feedback. This is the D01 wait.

grader_mapping.title: Today's past slots offered as free, refused only after Book
grader_mapping.reason: Today's slots that have started are shown as free and are refused only at the final submit.

grader_mapping.title: Permit not checked on the vehicle step, only after Book
grader_mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty or malformed permit, and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field.

grader_mapping.title: Post-Book errors (permit, past slot, expired hold) not linked to their fix
grader_mapping.reason: The states named are the permit errors after Book. The resident must work out how to get back to the vehicle step, which is the D07 confirm-page permit error.

grader_mapping.title: 5-minute hold expires with no warning, display or extension
grader_mapping.reason: The five-minute hold runs out unseen and the slot is dropped at submit.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle-step error summary links target non-focusable containers
grader_mapping.reason: Keyboard and screen-reader residents who activate an error link are not put on the vehicle buttons or waste checkboxes they need to fix. They have to hunt for the control after an error.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown with Car chosen, no 'vans and trailers only' wording
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule is not stated at the field and its explanation sits behind the icon-only info button. Stating the rule at the field would fix that part of D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booked' page does not restate day, time window or vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page is missing the day, the slot and the vehicle.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' opens a blank first step, forgetting the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' opens with Today pressed and no slot chosen, and nothing says what is kept.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown and labelled the same for every vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The rule that only vans and trailers need a permit is stated only behind the info button and on the first page, not where the field is.

grader_mapping.title: Permit rule hidden behind an icon-only (i) button
grader_mapping.reason: This is the D07 rule hidden behind an icon-only info button.

grader_mapping.title: Permit help has no link to apply and no timing
grader_mapping.reason: A van owner booking the evening before is told to apply on the council site but gets no link and no word on whether a permit can arrive in time. They cannot act on it from the page.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step does not repeat the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: The choice is shown again on the confirm page before booking, which is the usual check-your-answers pattern. Any harm from leaving it off the middle step is speculative.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking
grader_mapping.reason: Residents book in the evening or at weekends, but changing or freeing a slot needs a weekday phone call. Someone whose plans change at the weekend cannot move or release the slot.

grader_mapping.title: No screen says how long a chosen slot is held
grader_mapping.reason: The hold and its end are shown nowhere, which is D08.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: The same unseeded problem as F-0067: residents who change a booking at their usual time, outside weekday phone hours, have no way to do it.

grader_mapping.title: No indication anywhere of the hold time
grader_mapping.reason: No page shows the hold time or time remaining before 'This slot is no longer available'. This is D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled out of time order into an unlabelled group
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' slots are moved to the front of the grid, out of time order and away from their Morning/Afternoon headings.

grader_mapping.title: Done page lacks booked day, time and vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page is missing the day, the slot and the vehicle.

grader_mapping.title: Expired hold keeps 'Book this slot' as primary while slot shows '–'
grader_mapping.reason: This describes how the confirm page behaves when the hold has lapsed: the slot is replaced by a dash and the page offers no way forward. That is the D08 harm.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown before a vehicle is chosen; rule behind (i)
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule is stated only behind the info button, which is D07.

grader_mapping.title: At 320 px the slot grid is wider than the header rule and card
grader_mapping.reason: The slot grid overflows to a 335 px page at 320 px. This is the same overflow seen from its visual side.

grader_mapping.title: Slot-count status not announced (live region inserted with its text)
grader_mapping.reason: The status line '20 slots free on ...' gets aria-live only together with its text, so screen readers are not told about the slots.

grader_mapping.title: No progress during the 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
grader_mapping.reason: Choosing a permit vehicle takes 1.2 s before the permit field appears, with nothing shown meanwhile. The instructions place the delayed permit field under D07.

grader_mapping.title: Layout shift above the 0.1 budget on / (moves #opening)
grader_mapping.reason: CLS is 0.169 when the slots arrive, and #opening moves. This is the D02 page jump.
